Act as the implementation sub-agent for this task.

Fix GitHub issue #238 in Moneo.

Add a bounded Playwright job to pull-request CI (.github/workflows/):
- It starts its own disposable moneo-qa backend in the CI runner and uses the existing qa:auth and qa:server commands.
- Extend an existing whole-user journey in e2e/ to cover accepting a proposal card (applied exactly once) and declining one (not applied). Check the result after a refresh, and cover duplicate clicks and undo where supported.
- Mock AI.
- On failure, upload sanitized traces and screenshots.
- Document how to reproduce it locally in e2e/README.md.

Make sure the new CI job passes on your PR (`gh pr checks <n>`). Keep fixing it until it's green, or explain exactly why it can't be.

## RESUME: earlier work may exist
A stopped agent may have left uncommitted work in `C:/Users/mgsuk/.t3/worktrees/Moneo/t3-d21039d9-175739a3aa65d6d8` (branch `t3/issue-238-playwright-pr-ci`).
- Inspect it read-only (`git -C <path> status`, `git -C <path> diff`) and bring over what's useful.
- Never modify, reset or delete that worktree.
- Use your own branch `t3/issue-238-e2e-ci`, created from current `origin/main`.
- Commit as soon as the earlier work is applied, and after each step.

## Rules
- Read AGENTS.md first and follow it exactly. Read `gh issue view 238 --comments`.
- End each commit message with:
  Co-Authored-By: Claude <noreply@anthropic.com>
- **Don't end your turn while a command or CI run is still going.** Wait in the same turn: a foreground command with a long timeout, or a background command plus `t3_background_wait`.
- **Never kill a process you didn't start yourself in this session, verified by PID.** Never kill by name or command line.
- Run one `npm ci` at a time. If it stalls, retry once with `--prefer-offline`.
- The local QA app on port 3100 and the moneo-qa backend are shared with other agents:
  - Never run `npm run qa:reset` or `docker compose -p moneo-qa down`.
  - Never touch the owner's backend (.env, port 3000, project `moneo`).
  - If 3100 is busy, wait and retry.
- **Run `npm run lint` and `npm run typecheck` yourself and quote their last lines in your final reply.** CI rejected earlier agents' PRs that claimed these passed.
- Before finishing, also run `npm test`. Report 5-second timeouts under load in files you didn't touch, but don't change them.
- Push and open a PR to `main` (`Closes #238`), ending the body with:
  🤖 Generated with [Claude Code](https://claude.com/claude-code)
  Never merge.
- Final line: PR <full URL>, head <SHA>, checks and reviews <state>.

result.output:
Run browser journeys in pull-request CI and cover proposal decisions
Parent tracker: #224

**Priority:** P1 (correctness, security or verification priority).

## Problem and current evidence

The current CI file runs unit, lint, typecheck, build, bundle and database checks, but has no Playwright job. Earlier render-test cleanup also identified no browser proof that accepting or declining proposal cards invokes and persists the intended action.

## Scope

Add a bounded Playwright CI job using the disposable moneo-qa backend and existing QA auth/server commands. Extend an existing whole-user journey for proposal acceptance and decline rather than adding copy-only tests. Mock AI/bank/Scalable. Upload failure traces and screenshots, with no owner records or credentials.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] PR CI drives the isolated QA app and refuses owner backend targets.
- [ ] Accept applies the proposed change exactly once; decline does not apply it; refreshed UI matches stored state.
- [ ] Relevant undo and duplicate-click behaviours are exercised where supported.
- [ ] Browser failures fail CI and retain useful sanitized artifacts.
- [ ] Document local reproduction in e2e/README.md; avoid redundant backend setup where practical.

## Verification and constraints

Reproduce the current behaviour before changing it. Run the smallest relevant check during implementation, then npm test, npm run lint and npm run typecheck; add a build for app/config changes and real QA browser verification for changed user flows. Use only disposable moneo-qa services, synthetic records and mocked paid integrations. Verify source installation and desktop compatibility. Preserve financial history, corrections and undo. Do not add prose or comments in place of a deterministic boundary.

## Delivery

This issue records follow-up work; it does not claim the change is implemented. Recheck current main and #224 before starting, since the audit counts may have changed. Keep the PR focused and link its checks and relevant evidence here.
